atoms.title: Password-attack signs (failed attempts, unusual times, unknown devices)
atoms.objective: Read an authentication log, identify the three key signals of a password attack (repeated failed attempts, logins at anomalous times, and access from unknown devices), and write a rule that flags brute-force attempts...

atoms.title: Weak authentication patterns; adversary dictionary construction
atoms.objective: Evaluate a password against the core weakness criteria (length, dictionary membership, character variety, and sequential/repeated patterns) and explain how adversaries build and use wordlists to attack weak passwords.

atoms.title: Strengthening authentication: length/complexity, randomness, MFA
